October 31, 2026


We're proud to be sponsoring the[Women in Nuclear - Canada](https://facebook.com/180353562160135) Conference this week in Niagara Falls, and even prouder to have so many members of our Cameco team contributing to the discussions. It's been an wonderful opportunity to connect with industry colleagues, share knowledge and celebrate the people helping shape the future of nuclear energy. We're looking forward to one more day of learning, collaboration and inspiration tomorrow. Last but not least, a big congratulations to our own Christa Ingalls on her new role as Director on the Women in Nuclear Canada Board! #WiN2026 #WomenInNuclear[#NuclearEnergy](https://facebook.com/hashtag/NuclearEnergy)
